title: Lucida: Parse, Generate, and Place for Composable Real-to-Sim Scene Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2608.30821v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Composable scene modeling aims to recover a real indoor scene as complete, editable object assets arranged as observed, giving robot simulation and embodied AI a simulation-ready replica of the real environment whose objects can be manipulated individually. Existing pipelines decompose the task into three steps---parse the observations into instances, generate an asset for each, and place each asset back---but every step presumes an input that a cluttered capture rarely provides: accurate instance geometry, unoccluded views, and assets that accurately match the observations. We propose Lucida, which keeps this order but redistributes the requirements, so each step consumes only what a real capture reliably provides and precision is reached at the end of the pipeline rather than demanded at its start. translated_title: Lucida：面向可组合真实到仿真场景建模的解析、生成与放置
translated_abstract: 可组合场景建模旨在将真实室内场景恢复为按观测布局排列的完整、可编辑的对象资产，为机器人仿真和具身智能提供一个仿真就绪的真实环境副本，其中每个对象都可以被单独操作。现有流程将任务分解为三个步骤——将观测解析为实例、为每个实例生成资产、将每个资产放置回原位——但每一步都假设输入具备杂乱采集场景中很少能提供的条件：准确的实例几何、无遮挡的视角，以及与观测精确匹配的资产。我们提出Lucida，它保持这一流程顺序，但重新分配了各步骤的要求，使每一步只消耗真实采集可靠提供的信息，精度在流程末端达到而非在起点就被要求。Lucida将视频解析为场景图，其节点携带每个实例的多视角证据，并为每个实例生成完整的资产……
tldr: 提出Lucida框架，通过在解析、生成、放置三个步骤间重新分配输入要求，使可组合的真实到仿真场景建模仅依赖真实采集可靠提供的信息，从而在流程末端而非起点实现精度要求。
en_tdlr: Lucida redistributes the input requirements across the parse-generate-place pipeline, enabling composable real-to-sim scene modeling to rely only on what cluttered real captures reliably provide and achieve precision at the end of the pipeline rather than demanding it at the start.
